verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs describe the flow end to end: `foreloop init` installs the task-executor skill into the checkout, and connecting GitHub is what lets an agent open PRs. The agent (Claude Code or Codex) then claims approved tasks, does the work, and opens a pull request from your GitHub account. Missing for 10: documented options for configuring the PR itself (branch naming, draft vs. ready, reviewers), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that PRs are actually opened on task completion.
